verdict.rationale: Data and configuration portability is a fair question for a hosted browser-agent platform, but the evidence never documents exporting scraped data or job configurations for migration to another provider. The closest items are adjacent: the Downloads API retrieves files a session downloaded, and the Optimize tool turns an Agent run into a Stagehand script. Neither is described as a portable export or migration path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in
